builds.name: Reference: Ranked bot core
builds.goal: Reference for Nilah: the core and runes ranked Emerald+ bot players use most (3,089 ranked Emerald+ games with this core on OP.GG, patch 16.20, 59.9% win rate).
builds.hypothesis: A close-range marksman who gains reach and cone attacks after Q, then commits with dashes and an area pull. Crit and allied healing/shielding are integral to her scaling and survival. The current adc provider core anchors this plan; later slots are observed options or reviewed kit completions. Core in purchase order: The Collector → Infinity Edge → Lord Dominik's Regards. Conqueror keystone as played in those games. Remaining slots: Gluttonous Greaves, Bloodthirster, Guardian Angel.
builds.summary: The proven bot baseline: The Collector → Infinity Edge → Lord Dominik's Regards, with Conqueror.
testPlan: Play it in bot as your control build. Follow the purchase order; the core (The Collector → Infinity Edge → Lord Dominik's Regards) is what ranked players complete first.
Record kills, deaths, damage dealt and the minute you finish each core item, then compare other builds against these numbers in similar games.
Adapt the last two items to the enemy team: armor or magic resist against fed carries, anti-heal against healing, penetration once enemies stack resists.
failureConditions: Your results with this build fall clearly below the 59.9% ranked baseline over several games in the same role.
The enemy team composition makes the core items poor answers; swap the flexible slots before abandoning the core.
tradeoffs: Proven and predictable, so opponents know what to expect. It is a starting point, not the best build for every matchup.
The observed core and individual options do not establish six-item build statistics. Late slots are kit-based inferences.
Six-slot completion is our kit-based inference, not an observed six-item win-rate build.  Situational options replace an appropriate slot; they are not added as a seventh item.
buyOrder: Core in purchase order: The Collector → Infinity Edge → Lord Dominik's Regards.
Boots after the first item unless the lane needs them earlier.
coverageNotes: Source: OP.GG ranked Emerald+ solo/duo, patch 16.20, checked 2026-10-14. Core items and rune page are observed; later slots are observed options or reviewed completions. Win rates describe those games, not a prediction for yours.
builds.author: Rift Build Lab ranked data

kitEvidence.formula:
Passive: Nilah gains [(0.3) × Stat(8)] Armor Penetration, and her Attacks against champions restore [(0.2) × Stat(8)] damage dealt as Health. Overhealing from this is converted into a Shield for [4] seconds.

Active: Nilah cracks her whip-blade, dealing [(0 / 10 / 20 / 30 / 40 + (1) × AD) × ((1 + ((0.7) × Stat(8)) × (((1) × Stat(9) + -1))))] physical damage. If an enemy unit or structure is hit, Nilah gains 125 Attack Range and [characterLevelInterpolation(10 → 60; raw flags preserved)]% Attack Speed, and her Attacks hit in a cone for [4] seconds.

Nilah envelops herself in mist for [2.25] seconds, becoming Ghosted, gaining [(0.15 / 0.175 / 0.2 / 0.225 / 0.25) × 100]% Move Speed, dodging Attacks, and reducing magic damage taken by [25]%.

While active, touching allied champions envelops them in mist, granting the same benefits for [1.5] seconds.
Nilah dashes through a unit, dealing [60 / 70 / 80 / 90 / 100 + (0.2) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage to any enemies she passes through.

When Nilah kills a minion, she and her nearest ally gain [50]% of the experience they would have normally lost from sharing the kill.

Nilah gains [7.5]% increased effectiveness from healing and [15]% from shielding given to her by allied champions abilities. If an ally heals or shields her, they will also gain the increased amount of the shield or heal themselves. If an ally shields or heals themself, Nilah will also gain that additional effect.

Nilah whirls her whip-blade, dealing [(15 / 25 / 35 + (0.1) × AD[statFormula=2]) × (4)] physical damage over 1 second, then finishes with a burst of [125 / 225 / 325 + (1) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage that also Pulls nearby enemies toward her.

Apotheosis heals Nilah and her nearby allies for [0.2 + (0.1) × Stat(8)] (+@spell.NilahQ:CritLifesteal@ {{ Spell_NilahQ_Name }}) of the damage dealt to enemy champions, converting any overhealing into a Shield for [6] seconds.

builds.name: Apotheosis damage medic
builds.summary: Test apotheosis damage medic against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test apotheosis damage medic against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: Apotheosis heals nearby allies from physical champion damage, with a documented crit-linked healing term; Ardent can reward allies healed while Visage supports Nilah's own receipt. Essence Reaver adds physical Spellblade and mana, and crit also feeds Q penetration/healing.
testPlan: Required state: Group with attack-based allies inside R heal range.
Measure ally Ardent uptime and R healing against standard crit at equal gold.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Buying Ardent reduces personal damage and a low-damage R produces little healing.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Joy Unending's amplification explicitly concerns allied champion abilities, not every item shield.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Essence Reaver, Infinity Edge, Bloodthirster, Spirit Visage, Ardent Censer, Mercury's Treads. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

builds.name: Situational adaptation: Physical matchup
builds.goal: Situational adaptation for Nilah: adapt to the specified fight rather than assume one universal build
builds.hypothesis: A close-range marksman who gains reach and cone attacks after Q, then commits with dashes and an area pull. Crit and allied healing/shielding are integral to her scaling and survival. Compare crit-linked kit benefits and attack reach during Q with a noncrit duel experiment. Do not assume BotRK/Trinity inherits the value of missing crit scaling. Armor and access may turn survival into additional attack/spell windows.
builds.summary: Armor and access may turn survival into additional attack/spell windows.
testPlan: Kit question for Nilah: Compare crit-linked kit benefits and attack reach during Q with a noncrit duel experiment. Do not assume BotRK/Trinity inherits the value of missing crit scaling.

Start with the early core (Stridebreaker, then matchup armor) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Compare against the reference route at the same level, gold spent, finite stacks and opponent setup. Record unused gold; isolate an item change before changing runes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Armor and access may turn survival into additional attack/spell windows. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern. Choose the opponent profile this defensive route is intended to address, then repeat against the wrong damage type.

Q evidence: With a snap of her whip-blade, Nilah damages any enemies she hits in a straight line in her chosen direction. This action extends her attack range for a short duration. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Randuin is conditional on the enemy attack/crit profile; it costs an offensive slot.

The route fails Nilah's stated kit question: Compare crit-linked kit benefits and attack reach during Q with a noncrit duel experiment. Do not assume BotRK/Trinity inherits the value of missing crit scaling.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Randuin is conditional on the enemy attack/crit profile; it costs an offensive slot.
Full cost 16,100 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
Counter-items are conditional. Change boots/defense for the real matchup, then record the modified setup.
buyOrder: Stridebreaker, then matchup armor. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Randuin's Omen, Spirit Visage, Sterak's Gage are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

builds.hypothesis: Jubilant Veil dodges attacks for 2.25 seconds, creating a short melee attack opening; Titanic and Bloodmail exchange crit ceiling for health and physical attack pressure. Hexplate extends the attack phase after R while Essence Reaver preserves mana and Q's crit-linked benefits remain partial.

Compare health remaining and damage during Veil against physical versus spell opponents.
